question: Which of the following body parts behaves like a stretched rubber sheet?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Eardrum.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The eardrum of our body behaves like a stretched rubber sheet. Sound vibrations make the eardrum vibrate. The eardrum sends vibrations to the inner ear. From there, the signal goes to the brain.
 
• The **tympanic membrane is called the eardrum**.
 
• The tympanic membrane is a** thin layer of tissue in the human ear **that receives sound vibrations from the outer air and transmits them to the auditory ossicles, which are tiny bones in the tympanic (middle-ear) cavity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/944b945db5125b91a2442a12d0d269eb51d2d15c9a5531940f6527663c6277e5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An Ear consists of three major sections namely: Outer Ear, middle ear, and Inner Ear.
